title: Building D: 800 VDC bus fault on path D-A
summary: A fault on the 800 VDC bus of path D-A: the bus main SSCB and the BESS breaker cleared it. The hall rides on path D-B. Isolate the bus from its source, record the fault cleared (training step for the insulation test and repair), then reset and re-energise in order: rectifier input, SSCB, BESS. Simulated plant (ADR-023). Lockout at the equipment is outside this simulator. Switching the procedure does not call for counts as a violation.

steps.text: Acknowledge the Building D path A alarms in the alarm banner
Open the rectifier group A input breaker (bus isolated from its source)
Record the bus fault cleared (SSCB D-A: Record fault cleared)
Close the rectifier group A input breaker
Close SSCB D-A: path D-A carries load again
Reset and close the BESS D-A breaker (ride-through restored)
